rule.statement: Substantial compliance is sufficient for a husband's consent to be given in writing for his wife to agree to part with her property.
rule.supporting_quote: Of course, the husband can write “ I do hereby consent” or a similar sentence when he signs the document giving his consent but if the said phrase showing the consent in writing is not placed on the 14 document, can that document be branded as ‘not valid’ only due to that reason. I am of the opinion that substantial compliance takes place once the husband places his signature on the document.
